axes.range_rationale: The original other vehicle is held until frame 360, then physically released. Frames 320 and 400 bracket that existing command by two seconds while remaining inside the same 600-frame capture. These are physical timing commands, not immediate-hazard cutoffs.
axes.spacing_rationale: Forty 20 Hz frames are two seconds; the three commands separate the other approach timing enough to seek observable proximity variation. Realized entry and hazard review remain independent.
axes.feasibility_evidence: runner.py other_control applies the actual other-vehicle Native VehicleControl after the bounded release frame; tests/test_officer_runner.py::test_staged_other_vehicle_approach exercises 320/360/400 command behavior.

limitations: A visible uniform or commanded gesture alone does not establish legal police authority or actual control.
Native body history and camera review do not supply a numerical legal threshold for cautious proceeding or immediate hazard.
Physical visibility, motion and device governance require later original capture review.
